# Investor revision
Execute MEGA_PROMPT.md in presentations. Preserve baseline and immutable provenance. Commercial and financing choices are proposals pending founder approval. No production deployment.

# Handoff
## Current Status
Execution underway.
## Completed Phases
See revision-report.md.
## Known Issues
Model provider failed twice; this manifest is assistant-authored and compiled through the documented offline seam.
## Next Agent Notes
Verify actual artifacts; do not equate pack validation with task success.

# Decisions
## Confirmed
Review branch, no deploy; retain truthful limitations.
## Open
Financing, compensation, paid wedge, pricing and hiring require founder approval.
## Log
2026-11-11: Recommend $500/month team service as proposed base, enterprise separate.

# Implementation prompt
Work autonomously through all phases of MEGA_PROMPT.md. Read MASTER.md and TODO.md. Preserve evidence, never invent claims, run checks and record blockers. Do not deploy.

# Review prompt
Review implementation against MEGA_PROMPT.md and REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md. Check evidence, financial formulas, all slides, SEO before/after and actual command results. Independent review is not claimed until performed.

# Review
## Claims
- [ ] Each material assertion sourced or labeled.
- [ ] No invented traction.
## Product
- [ ] Pricing coherent.
- [ ] Founder decisions explicit.
## Quality
- [ ] Build and tests recorded.
- [ ] Desktop and mobile inspected.
- [ ] SEO baseline preserved and after compared.

# audit
## Goal
Preserve untouched generated and live baseline; inspect all slides and pinned sources.
## Read before starting
MEGA_PROMPT.md and repository AGENTS.md.
## Scope
Preserve untouched generated and live baseline; inspect all slides and pinned sources.
## Out of scope
Deployment, invented facts, external messages.
## Implementation notes
Use current source and retained receipts; preserve historical evidence.
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Required artifacts exist and can be reopened.
- [ ] Checks support claims or blockers are explicit.
## Suggested checks
Use commands in revision-report.md and scoped Loop Engineering gates.
## Handoff requirements
Record evidence paths, results and open decisions.
